meta.title: Wastelands: Breakaway
meta.notes: 30 sections (S01–S30) plus Good/Bad/Special endings. All endings loop to S01.
meta.blurb: You were forged by the Brotherhood of Steel. Now you’re running from it—into a wasteland that does not forgive weakness.

S01.text:
The Brotherhood taught you discipline, order, and obedience.

They did not teach you how to live without permission.

The bunker hums with generators and old-world machines.

Tonight, you make your choice.

You leave.

S02.text:
You rip the fusion core free.

Alarms wail instantly.

The bunker erupts into motion—boots pounding steel, voices shouting orders.

You run with the weight of betrayal burning in your chest.

S03.text:
You move carefully, avoiding patrol routes burned into your memory.

A guard nearly catches you.

You hold your breath.

He passes.

You reach the outer hatch.

S04.text:
You fire first.

The corridor fills with smoke and sparks.

You don’t look back when someone screams your name.

S05.text:
You slam the blast door controls.

The door grinds shut behind you.

The Brotherhood will not forget this.

S06.text:
The wasteland stretches endless and ruined.

Dead highways. Rusted cars. Wind carrying radioactive dust.

You are free.

You are alone.

choices.label: HEAD TOWARD SMOKE ON THE HORIZON

S07.text:
You approach a scavenger camp.

Armed men and women eye you carefully.

They don’t trust Brotherhood deserters.

Not at first.

S08.text:
The road leads you to a slaver outpost.

Cages line the perimeter.

Screams carry on the wind.

S09.text:
You demonstrate your training.

Weapon maintenance. Tactics. Discipline.

The scavengers accept you—for now.

S10.text:
The raid is brutal.

Gunfire. Blood. Chains breaking.

The slavers fall.

Survivors scatter into the wastes.

S11.text:
You travel alone again.

Your Brotherhood armor draws attention.

Some good. Some bad.

S12.text:
The freed captives thank you.

One warns you of Legion patrols nearby.

Roman armor. Red banners.

S13.text:
You scavenge useful gear.

A map marked with faction territory catches your eye.

Brotherhood. NCR. Legion. Institute.

S14.text:
The wasteland punishes hesitation.

Radiation storms roll in.

You take shelter among ruins.

S15.text:
Roman Legion soldiers march into view.

Discipline. Cruelty. Order through fear.

They see your armor and smile.

S16.text:
You reach NCR land.

Rangers question you harshly.

They distrust the Brotherhood—but hate the Legion more.

S17.text:
You ambush the Legion patrol.

It’s fast and violent.

Their commander falls at your feet.

S18.text:
You play along.

They talk freely—plans to raid NCR settlements.

Information is a weapon.

S19.text:
NCR officers offer you protection.

In exchange, they want intel on the Brotherhood.

You feel the old chains tug again.

S20.text:
The banner makes you a target.

Both feared and hunted.

Whispers follow you across the wasteland.

S21.text:
Your missions for NCR bring stability.

But rumors spread of an underground faction.

Cold. Precise. Watching.

S22.text:
Raiders rally behind you.

You become a symbol—of freedom or fear.

S23.text:
You find a hidden facility.

Synthetic guards. Clean steel.

The Institute reveals itself.

S24.text:
You survive, but remain hunted.

The wasteland never forgets.

S25.text:
A massive conflict erupts.

Factions clash.

You must choose who you become.

S26.text:
The Institute offers you a place.

Order without chaos.

Control without freedom.

S27.text:
You cripple the Institute’s operations.

Alarms scream.

Synths fall.

S28.text:
You vanish into the ruins.

Your legend grows.

S29.text:
You find a settlement willing to trust you.

They ask for leadership.

S30.text:
You look back at the Brotherhood bunker on the horizon.

You were forged by steel.

But you were not meant to stay caged.

END_GOOD.text:
GOOD ENDING — A NEW ORDER

You build something better.

Not perfect. Not clean.

But free.

END_BAD.text:
BAD ENDING — THE WASTELAND WINS

The wasteland claims another name.

Steel rusts. Bones bleach.

END_SPECIAL.text:
SPECIAL ENDING — A LIVING LEGEND

You belong nowhere.

Stories follow you across the wastes.

Some call you hero.

Others curse your name.
